_about: Where things live and how pictures are checked. Paths are relative to the project folder. To change something on one machine only (for example the Mac), put just those keys in server/settings.local.json; it is never committed.
_device: auto = cuda (NVIDIA), then mps (Mac), then cpu. Or name one.
_use_3060_settings: For a 12 GB graphics card like the RTX 3060: a lighter VAE (the step that turns the result into pixels) that works in half precision, used in tiles, and long prompts read in full with Compel (otherwise the model reads only the first 77 tokens). Not needed on the Mac. Switched on the Settings page, which saves it in settings.local.json.
_custom: Where the Custom tab starts (its own theme, no theme file behind it). The model is the first one in the models folder unless named here.

custom.negative: lowres, worst quality, bad quality, blurry, bad anatomy, bad hands, text, watermark

_max_pictures: Most pictures one Generate can make (Advanced tab).
_unload_after_minutes: Let go of the model when no pictures have been made for this long, so the graphics card's memory is free. The next picture then takes a few seconds longer to start. 0 = let go as soon as the queue is empty.
_max_queue: Most picture jobs waiting or being made at once. More requests are turned away until some finish.

safety._about: Every picture is checked by both checkers and is not shown if either one scores it at or above the threshold. Up to 'tries' pictures are made before giving up. 'negative' is added to every theme's negative prompt.
safety.negative: nsfw, nude, nudity, naked, topless, nipples, genitals, explicit, sexual
